id.description: The character id exactly as given.

instruct.description: One or two declarative sentences describing the voice for a voice-design text-to-speech model: sex, apparent age, pitch, timbre, pace, accent or register, habitual mood. No quotes, no hedging, no character names, no plot.

sample_text.description: Two plain sentences, 18 to 30 words in total, that this character could say in an ordinary moment: their register and mood, but no proper nouns, numbers, abbreviations, or plot. This becomes the reference clip the voice is cloned from.
